reviews.review:
I was genuinely impressed with Kano – Stone Islands! Knowing that this game was created by a single developer makes the whole experience even more amazing. The world is crafted with so much care, and the puzzle design is wonderfully creative — several moments made me stop and think in the best way possible. The gameplay feels smooth, the atmosphere is relaxing, and the overall vibe of the islands is incredibly immersive.

There are a few small shortcomings here and there, but nothing major — just tiny details that you might notice while playing. Thankfully, they don’t really affect the experience in any meaningful way. The core gameplay is solid, enjoyable, and keeps you curious about what comes next.

Overall, I highly recommend buying this game. If you enjoy thoughtful puzzles, calm exploration, and supporting passionate solo developers, this one is absolutely worth it. It’s a charming adventure that definitely deserves a place in your library!
